acceptanceCriteria: A PR touching a Go test file that fails `GOOS=windows go vet` fails PR CI before merge, shown by a test PR or a fixture run.
Added PR wall time is measured and recorded; the job is skipped when no Go file changes.
Owner consent per decision 0390 is recorded.
body: Two Windows cross-vet breaks reached main within two days: V1-1092 (prompt_fragments_test.go missing its darwin||linux tag) and b0b82698 from V1-0825 (`undefined: stubStageSleep` in a tagged test helper), both caught only by the nightly release-gates run and fixed in RC3 lane F (PR beamfall/corvint#739, 30bb2a06 and 6ab011ab). PR CI builds for Windows but does not vet test files. Proposal: run `GOOS=windows go vet ./...` (or `make cross-vet`) in a PR job, ideally only when Go files change per the affected plan. A .github change needs owner consent per decision 0390.
title: PR CI should type-check test files for Windows so cross-vet breaks stop reaching main
